title: Daily 5, Sat 21 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: A mother is 3 times as old as her daughter. The sum of their ages is 48 years. How old is the daughter, in years?
How many integers x satisfy x² < 30?
Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 7. When 5 is added to each, the ratio becomes 5 : 8. What is the larger original number?
Two successive discounts of 10% and 20% are equal to a single discount of what percent?
A train 120 m long runs at 45 km/h. A man walks at 9 km/h in the same direction beside the track. In how many seconds does the train pass him completely?
